title: Bachelor of Pharmacy Admission
content:
Admission Requirements

General Information

DMU admits academically qualified and morally sound students irrespective of their national origin, color, gender, religion or disability. Applicants who submit completed application forms and all supporting materials to the Admission & Registration Unit by the specified deadlines shall be notified on their decision through their email. Early admission is granted to outstanding students as evidenced by their high school achievements. Fulfilling the following admission requirements does not guarantee admission to a program. These requirements represent a threshold for including the application in the competition pool. Admission is competitive and subject to availability of spaces in the desired program. The following stipulations pertain to admission to undergraduate programs. Admission requirements for graduate studies are found in the Graduate Studies Catalog. Admission Requirements: All applicants must satisfy the following basic admission requirements:

  1. Completion of secondary education or an equivalent level with the required average.
  2. The applicant should not have been dismissed from the DMU or any other institution for academic or disciplinary reasons.
  3. Applicants are accepted in different colleges and programs according to the student’s preference and the grade average and depending on the capacity of each college.
  4. Applicants should complete and submit the application form and required documents to the Admissions Department by the stated deadlines and pay the non-refundable application fee of AED 1050 (including 5% VAT).
  5. This application fee is non-refundable if the applicant is rejected or withdrawn from the university.
  6. The applicants who are still in their high school seats will receive conditional admission until the final results are submitted, and fulfil the requirements based on competitive criteria.
  7. A student will not be issued an ID or allowed to register for courses unless the admission file is complete, and the tuition fees are paid

Important General Notes:

  • Students fill out the application form personally and are responsible for the accuracy of the information filled. Incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • Students are responsible for completing all admission procedures by the specified deadlines, by the instructions of the Admissions Office as announced on the University Website. The university is not responsible for applications not completed by students on time. All students are required to visit the University’s website (www.dmu.edu) to learn about the dates and locations of the admission Admission Committee (26-27) exams, English proficiency requirements, and interviews as well as to see the status of their application.
  • Admission is granted for the semester to which the student is applying. A student’s admission will be -withdrawn if the student does not enroll in the same semester as when the application has been submitted.
  • The university does not take the original High School Certificates. Students are required to provide copies certified by the recognized authorities.
  • The University reserves the right to increase the fees every year. g. Students shall abide by all other university requirements.
  • Academic Qualifications:
  • Before being admitted, the student must have completed at least 12 years of school prior to joining DMU.
  • The applicant should have graduated from a school licensed and recognized by the Ministry of Education in the UAE and must submit a certified copy of the secondary school certificates, with a grade script certified by the school and the Ministry of Education or the Education Zone in the UAE.

An applicant who attended school outside the UAE should be a graduate of a school recognized by the official education authority in the country of study. Certificates submitted must be authenticated by the Education Authority in the country of study, such as the Ministry of Education, Boards of Education, or the British Council, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the country, then the relevant Embassy of the United Arab Emirates or the Embassy of the Country in the UAE, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the United Arab Emirates.

DMU General Admission Requirements:

Applicants to different programs of DMU must submit the following:

  1. Attested High School Certificate and transcript (Grade 12 or Equivalent in each curriculum).
  2. Attested School certificate and transcript for Grade 10 and 11
  3. Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for High School curriculums other than UAE system:
    https://www.moe.gov.ae/En/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/CertEquivalent.aspx
  4. OR Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for international applicants with certificates:
    https://www.moe.gov.ae/en/eservices/servicecard/pages/certequivalent-out.aspx
  5. Successfully passing the DMU Admission Exam as per each program requirement.
  6. No separate English language proficiency test is required for applicants who have completed their high school education in a curriculum where English was the medium of instruction. Accepted evidence of English proficiency includes Academic IELTS 5.0, TOEFL PBT 500, TOEFL iBT 61, or a High School English score of 80% or above (or equivalent).
  7. If the English subject requirement isn’t met, Conditional Admission may be offered only to applicants scoring 75%–79% in English, provided they either (1) Admission Committee (26-27) pass a remedial English course in the first semester or (2) submit an English proficiency score (IELTS 5.0, TOEFL 500, iBT 61) before the start of the first semester.
  8. Successfully passing the interview per program requirements if applicable.
BPharm/ PharmD Programs:
  1. Graduation Stream:
    • Applicants must graduate from the Advanced Stream or equivalent.
  2. English Requirements:
    Applicants must submit one of the following: o
    • TOEFL iBT with a minimum score of 61 or CBT with a minimum score of 173 (Institutional TOEFL is not accepted).
    • Or Academic IELTS with a minimum Band 5.
    • Or Successful completion of the English course in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80% in the UAE curriculum or its equivalent in other curricula.
  3. Mathematics Requirement:
    • Successful completion of the mathematics course in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80% in the UAE curriculum or its equivalent in other curricula.
  4. Science Subjects Requirement (Chemistry, Biology, or Physics):
    • Successful completion of any two of these subjects in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80% in the UAE curriculum or its equivalent in other curricula.
  5. Placement Exam:
    • Students who score between 75% and 79.9% in Mathematics, English or any two science subjects can take a placement exam prepared by the University – restricted to one subject only.
  6. Remedial Courses:
    • Students who do not meet the English, Mathematics, or science (scores less than 80%) subject requirements in Grade 12 must enroll in non- credit remedial courses offered by the college or submit IELTS (Score 5).
  7. Passing the Interview:
    • As per CAA Standards 2019, applications are screened for completeness, coursework, and grades. Selected applicants are invited for an interview, conducted on campus or online, using a structured rubric. Admission committee members and pharmacy faculty evaluate candidates, who are also briefed on the process.
    • Based on interview results and other admission criteria, the committee recommends candidates to the Dean. Applicants are then informed of their admission status (accepted, wait-listed, or denied).
    • The interview will be conducted by the program director and admission committee.
Admission Criteria Per Curriculum

The UAE Curriculum:

  • Successful completion of the mathematics course in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80% in the Advanced Stream and 75% in the Elite Stream.
  • Science Subjects Requirement (Chemistry, Biology, or Physics): Successful completion of any two of these subjects in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80% in the in the Advanced Stream and 75% in the Elite Stream.

The British Curriculum:

  • Minimum grade of C or 5 in Mathematics and two science subjects – five O-Level subjects. including English,
    and
  • A minimum grade of D in two AS-Level subjects including Biology or Chemistry.
    OR
  • A minimum grade of D in one A-level subject including Biology or Chemistry.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory

The American Curriculum:

  • Successful completion of the mathematics course or its equivalent (e.g: Calculus / statistics) in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80%.
  • Science Subjects Requirement (Chemistry, Biology, or Physics): Successful completion of any two of these subjects in Grade 12 with a minimum score of 80%.
  • Applicant has to complete SAT1 Mathematics with a minimum score of 450 or equivalent as per MOE Equivalency requirements
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in UAE
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

The International Baccalaureate Curriculum (IB Diploma):

  • Applicants must achieve a minimum of twenty-four points.
  • Applicant must complete three science subjects including Biology and Chemistry
  • Applicant must achieve four points in two high level subjects.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

Indian Curriculum:
CBSE:

  • Applicants must achieve in grade 12 equivalent to 60% in the Science Stream - according to WES.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

State Board:

  • Applicants must achieve grade 12 equivalent to 60% in the Science Stream - according to WES.

Pakistani Federal Board:

  • Applicants must achieve in grade 12 equivalent to 60% in the Science Stream - according to WES.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

Additional Information for Secondary School Qualifications Obtained Outside UAE:

Applicants with high school certificate obtained outside the UAE – other than the qualifications listed above, are required to submit an Educational Credential Evaluators Admission Committee (26-27) (ECE) course-by-course evaluation when applying to evaluate the transcripts and have a standard GPA - http://www.ece.org

  • The applicant should be a graduate from a school recognized by the official education authority in the country of study.
  • Must meet the requirements for admission into university in the country of origin.
  • The applicant must complete 12 years of education in school and provide proof thereof.
  • Certificates submitted need to be attested from:
    • Education Authority (Home Country)
    • Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Home Country).
    • Embassy of the United Arab Emirates or the Embassy of the Country in the UAE
    • Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the United Arab Emirates
  • Applicants must submit Equivalency Certificate from Ministry of Education in UAE https://www.moe.gov.ae/en/eservices/servicecard/pages/certequivalent-out.aspx

Conditional Admission

Conditional offers may be extended to eligible students with pending equivalency certificate. Students are required to submit the equivalency certificate by the end of the first semester, failing which they may be withdrawn from the program.

Passing the Interview:

  • As per CAA Standards 2019, applications are screened for completeness, coursework, and grades. Selected applicants are invited for an interview, conducted on campus or online, using a structured rubric. Admission committee members and pharmacy faculty evaluate candidates, who are also briefed on the process.
  • Based on interview results and other admission criteria, the committee recommends candidates to the Dean. Applicants are then informed of their admission status (accepted, wait-listed, or denied).

BANK ACCOUNT INFORMATION

Once your bank transfer has been completed, please send a copy of the receipt with the name and student ID to accounts@dmu.ae.
Cash / Cheques / Credit Card:

Refund Policy of Tuition Fees

Dubai Medical University admits only a limited number of students. If any student withdraws after admission, this will create a vacancy that could have been used by another qualified student. Therefore, the University administration is strict in their action for such students. They will not refund the fees paid at the time of admission until a valid reason is provided for admission cancellation.

Refund applies as follows:

  • A 5% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal before the beginning of the academic year.
  • A 25% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal during the first 10 working days of the academic year.
  • A 50% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal after 10 working days of the academic year.
  • If a student withdraws after the second semester start, no refund is granted at all.
  • In case of unforeseen circumstances, refund may only be accepted after Deans’ Council review based on student request supported with evidence.
  • Hostel and Transportation fees are refunded based on pro rata on a full monthly basis, not per day. (Month fraction is considered as a full month).
  • Refund requests for the above valid reasons should be made through the Student Affairs Department in collaboration with Accounts Department through a written request along with the original fee receipt. Refunds will be made after clearance of dues, if any. Refunds will be credited by bank transfer or Cheque to the same payer (student’s parent / guardian / sponsor) bank account and not given in cash.

The following are non-refundable:

  • Visa fee
  • Application fee
  • Transport fee
  • Seat Reservation fee.
  • Full tuition fee in case of dismissal/suspension for disciplinary reasons
Scholarship and Discounts

DMU is keen to attract talented students and support their educational journey, as such we will offer Merit Scholarship to students as per criteria published.

  • Merit Scholarship for DMU Programs
  • Merit is based on academic performance.
Merit is based on academic performance.
  • BPharm / PharmD Programs
  • For continuing students, the top Five students are given the Merit Scholarship of 20% discount on the semester fees as per end of semester transcript percentage / GPA. For students in clinical years/clerkship training, the ranking will be based on end of rotation. If there is a tie in the score / GPA of students, the list is submitted to the Dean's Council for review and approval to allow both students to get the scholarship.
  • For new students, the details of the merit discount:
    For College of Pharmacy the following Scholarship Policy applies (for the Academic Year 25-26):
    • New Students scoring high school percentage from 90% to 94.9%: a 10% discount applies on the 1st semester fees
    • New Students scoring high school percentage from 95% to 96.9%: a 20% discount applies on the 1st semester fees
    • New Students scoring high school percentage from 97% to 98.9%: a 30% discount applies on the 1st semester fees
    • New Students scoring high school percentage of 99%: a 40% discount applies on the 1st semester fees
External Scholarships

Students can also be enrolled at DMU and receive external scholarships and this cannot be combined with any DMU internal scholarship or discounts. Sponsoring entities would pay the students fees and other expenses as per their agreement with the student. Students or sponsor are required to provide DMU Student Affairs and Finance department a written confirmation of the sponsorship or scholarship letter or agreement with the student. DMU is required to provide the sponsor with student transcripts, attendance records and invoices directly without prior notice to the student. If a student loses a scholarship, they are required to pay all pending fees to DMU.

Discounts

1. Siblings Discount
Siblings enrolled at DMU are eligible for a 10% discount on tuition fee only and are eligible for the second student that joins the program and 15% for the third, etc. Once the first student graduates the discount ceases and the student pay the whole tuition fee. This is not applicable for transportation or hostel fees.

2. Employee´s discount
Children of DMU faculty, staff and adjunct faculty are eligible for a 15% discount on Tuition annual fees.

title: Transfer from Other Colleges
content:
Transfer from other Colleges

Recognition of Prior Learning / Transfer Admission

The College also welcomes applications from candidates studying with other educational institutions in Diploma in Pharmacy/BPharm programs/Science/Dentist/Medicine who wish to transfer to COP. It may be possible to grant exemption from earlier part of the degree course in recognition of a candidate’s success in her previous course of study.

The following are the necessary conditions for transfer to the COP:

  • College of Pharmacy (COP) accepts transfer of students from accredited College with a curriculum that is comparable to that offered at COP.
  • The student must provide a letter of application to the Dean of the College specifying reason (s) for requesting transfer and desired date of transfer.
  • Dubai Pharmacy College requires applicants to submit their transcripts for evaluation of transferable subjects /teaching hours from previous College experiences.
  • No student who has been dismissed from any institute will be eligible for transfer to COP.
  • All applicants must provide conduct certificates from the institute where they are currently enrolled.
  • Student applying for transfer to COP must study more than 60% of the syllabus of B. Pharm at COP.
  • All applicants should contact the Dean’s office to inquire about having their transcripts reviewed.
  • The final decision for approval of transfer will be made by the Dean after review of the transfer request by the Chief Academic Officer of the College.
  • Transfer of students is not allowed after second year.
  • Before considering any application for transfer, existence of an appropriate seat for the student should be considered.

The faculty member should equate the transferred students in the Course Equivalency Form for Transfer Students.

Transfer admission policies for BPharm
  • Students must meet the English language proficiency requirements as set by the Ministry of Higher Education- Higher Education Affairs, UAE.
  • The student transferring from another accredited college must be in a good academic standing (a minimum CGPA of 2.0, C grade, on a 4.0 scale or equivalent).
  • Before attending Dubai Pharmacy College, attested records from the previous College and higher secondary school should be submitted to Head Enrollment and Records

title: Pharmacy Frequently Asked Questions
content:
College of Pharmacy Frequently Asked Questions

What are the programs offered?

Bachelor of Pharmacy (BPharm)
Master of Pharmacy - Clinical Pharmacy

How long is the duration of the BPharm program?

The duration of the BPharm program is 4 years and half.

How long is the duration of the MPharm program?

The duration of the MPharm program is 2 years.

How many students does College of Pharmacy plan to accept to the BPharm program in AY 2025-2026?

College of Pharmacy plans to offer 60 students for the BPharm program

How many students does College of Pharmacy plan to accept to the MPharm program in AY 2025-2026?

College of Pharmacy plans to offer 15 students for the MPharm program

How can I apply to the BPharm / MPharm Program?

Application to the either programs can only be submitted through our online application portal https://admissions.dmu.ae/Application to the program opens on January 22nd, 2025, and closes on 1st week of September, 2025. Late applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

For your application to be complete, you will need to submit the online application, upload all supporting documents, and pay the non-refundable application fee of AED 1050 (AED 1000 + 5% VAT).

What are the application requirements for BPharm program?

Please refer to Admission criteria in this link. https://dmu.ae/home/admissions/

Do I have to submit TOEFL / IELTS even if I am an American, British, Canadian national?

If you studied in schools where the medium of instruction is English, you are exempt from submitting TOEFL or IELTS, regardless of your nationality (British, American, Canadian, etc.).

In case I applied to College of Pharmacy in previous years, but I was not accepted. Can I re-apply?

Yes, you can reapply. Please send an email to admissions@dpc.edu to check eligibility before you submit the application.

I applied to College of Pharmacy in previous years, I was accepted but I was not able to join. Do I re-apply?

Yes, you need to submit a new application to be considered among the new applicants.

Is the BPharm program recognized internationally?

College of Pharmacy is accredited locally by Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), Ministry of Education UAE.
The BPhram program at College of Pharmacy is internationally accredited by the US Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education (ACPE).

What are the scholarship opportunities for students at College of Pharmacy?

College of Pharmacy is keen to attract talented students and support their educational journey, so we will offer Merit Scholarship, and discounts to students as per criteria published.

What happens after I submit my application for BPharm program? Admission Process:
How much is the tuition fees of the BPharam program?

Tuition fees for the Academic Year 2025-2026 is 45000 AED Plus 5% VAT.

How much is the tuition fees of the MPharam program?

Tuition fees for the Academic Year 2025-2026 is 50000 AED Plus 5% VAT.

Does the college provide accommodation?

Yes, we have a female only hostel that is managed by College of Pharmacy which is across the road from the campus. The cost is additional to the annual tuition fee.

For more information, please check link https://dmu.ae/home/college-of-pharmacy/dpcg-tuition-fees/

Does the college provide transportation?

Yes, we provide transportation, which is managed by College of Pharmacy, and the cost is additional to the annual tuition fee. Daily transportation facilities are available for several destinations. Each weekend buses take students staying at the hostel back to their homes in Abu Dhabi, Fujairah, Ras Al Khaimah and Al Ain and bring them back to the College on the next working day. Cost of Transport ranges from 3000 AED to 5000 AED according to destination.

Does DMU provide a student visa?

Yes, For more information, please check https://dmu.ae/home/visa-insurance/

How can I find out the status of my application in the BPharm / MPharm program

Log into the admission portal https://admissions.dmu.ae/ with your username and password to check your status. Below is explanation of each status:
Submitted: Application is submitted and being reviewed by College of Pharmacy.
Screened In: Application is complete, and you will be invited for the interview and Internal exam if applicable.
Screened Out: Applicant is not eligible to join the program.
Invited for Interview:you will receive an email with interview date, time and location.
Invited for Interview and Internal Exam:you will receive an email with Interview and Exam date, time, and location.
Initial Admission: you are eligible to join once you submit all required admission documents.
Waitlisted: You are on a wait list and will be contacted once a place is available.
Regret: you didn’t meet our admission requirements and hence we are not able to offer you admission.

How will applicants be ranked?

The ranking of applicants will be based on High School or bachelor’s degree and the performance during interview.

How can I get my equivalency certificate if I completed my high school or degree outside UAE?

Applicants who completed High School or a bachelor’s degree outside the UAE must have their certificates and transcripts / mark sheets attested by:

  • The issuing educational institute and / or recognized authority for education in the country in which you completed your education.
  • The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the country where you completed the degree.
  • The UAE Embassy in that country
  • The Ministry of Education in the UAE
  • Additionally, the UAE Ministry of Education must issue an Equivalency Certificate.

title: About College of Nursing
content:
About College of Nursing

College of nursing offers a pathway to a professional career that is both personally fulfilling and in high demand. Nurses are the backbone of the healthcare system, serving as patient advocates, educators, and leaders who blend scientific knowledge with genuine compassion to provide holistic care. The role of a nurse is versatile and extends beyond traditional hospital settings to include public health, education, research, and administration, offering a wide range of career paths and specialization opportunities. The healthcare sector is experiencing significant growth, and the Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a faster-than-average job growth for registered nurses and advanced practice registered nurses, ensuring excellent job security. A nursing education equips you with essential skills like critical thinking, problem-solving, and emotional resilience, which are crucial for success in a dynamic and ever-evolving field. Ultimately, a nursing degree is an investment in a stable career that allows you to make a tangible, positive impact on individuals and communities every day.

Welcome to the College of Health Sciences at Dubai Medical University.

Our mission is to educate and inspire the next generation of healthcare professionals who will contribute meaningfully to the advancement of patient care, healthcare systems, and community well-being. At the College of Health Sciences, we believe that excellence in health education requires a strong balance between scientific knowledge, clinical competence, ethical practice, and compassionate care.

One of our greatest strengths is our integration with Dubai Medical University Hospital (DMUH) within the Dubai Medical University Academic Health System. This close collaboration allows our students to benefit from a truly immersive learning environment where academic instruction and clinical practice are closely aligned. As healthcare continues to evolve rapidly, the need for highly skilled allied-health professionals has never been greater. Our college is committed to preparing graduates who are not only technically competent but also innovative, adaptable, and dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

I warmly invite you to explore our college and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Student Success Center

The Student Success Center (SSC) at the College of Nursing serves as a central hub for student support and guidance. It is designed to support students throughout their academic journey and personal growth by providing a supportive environment where they can seek assistance with academic, personal, or university-related concerns.

The SSC monitors student attendance and academic progress, identifies students who may require additional support, and works closely with students, faculty, academic programs, and university services to help students overcome challenges, stay engaged, and succeed in their studies. Through its various services, the SSC ensures that every student receives the guidance, assistance, and motivation needed to achieve academic success and personal development. These are in line with the UAE's strategic direction of promoting happiness and positivity.

Services provided:

    • Mentorship
    • Peer Tutoring
    • Student Attendance Monitoring
    • Student Grievances and Appeals
    • Academic Integrity and Conduct
    • Career Guidance

    The Student Success Center (SSC) is committed to supporting students throughout their academic journey by regularly monitoring academic progress and identifying students who may be at risk of academic difficulty. Through early intervention and personalized support, the SSC works closely with students, faculty mentors, and Associate Dean for Academic Affairs to identify challenges and develop effective strategies for academic success.

    As part of this support system, every student is assigned a faculty mentor who provides individualized academic guidance throughout their studies. Faculty mentors regularly monitor students' progress, meet with them to discuss academic performance, assist with academic planning, and help address any personal or academic challenges that may affect their success. They also support students in adjusting to university life, making informed academic decisions, and accessing appropriate university resources when needed.

    Through continuous mentoring, early intervention, and collaborative support, the SSC and faculty mentors help students stay on track, achieve their academic goals, and make the most of their university experience.

    The SSC organizes peer tutoring programs designed to create an inclusive learning community where students support each other in strengthening their understanding of course material and developing effective study strategies.

    Peer tutoring at DMU is delivered through structured, student-led initiatives under faculty supervision. The program is offered in a variety of learning formats, including one-to-one tutoring, small-group tutoring, study sessions, and workshops.

    Senior or high-achieving students support their colleagues in understanding challenging subjects, strengthening their knowledge, improving study habits, and building confidence in their learning.

    The SSC manages student attendance records and reviews absence excuses in learning and assessment sessions, in accordance with university policies. By maintaining accurate records, the SSC helps students stay on track with their studies and ensures transparency in attendance monitoring.

    Attendance alerts are sent regularly to students, and academic mentors are kept informed of attendance concerns to facilitate timely follow-up and support when needed.

    Absence & Missed Assessment Submission

    Students may sometimes face issues related to their academic or university experience. The SSC provides a clear process to submit grievances or appeals in a safe and fair environment. This ensures that student concerns are heard and addressed according to DMU policies. The SSC also guides students through the process and directs them to the appropriate individuals or committees when needed.

    Student Grievances and Appeals Submission

    The SSC promotes a culture of academic integrity, professionalism, and responsible conduct among students. The SSC provides guidance on university policies and supports students in understanding and meeting the expectations of the DMU community.

    The SSC also supports the implementation of the Student Misconduct and Academic Integrity Policy by assisting with the reporting, documentation, and follow-up of cases in accordance with university procedures. Students may seek guidance from the SSC regarding academic integrity and student conduct matters at any stage of the process.

    The Student Success Center (SSC) provides comprehensive career advising services to help students explore career options, develop professional skills, and prepare for a successful transition into the workforce. Through individual and group career advising sessions, students receive personalized guidance on career planning, goal setting, resume and interview preparation, and professional development.

    The SSC also organizes career readiness workshops, employer engagement events, and job fairs to connect students with potential employers and enhance their employability. In collaboration with internship and placement coordinators, employers, and professional organizations, the SSC helps identify internship, training, and potential employment opportunities for students, supporting their career growth and lifelong professional success.

The Student Success Center is dedicated to supporting you in achieving your full potential by providing academic support, student engagement opportunities, career guidance, wellbeing resources, and personalized development services tailored to your needs, while enhancing your overall university experience.

content:
Admission Requirements:

Nursing students have a wide range of career opportunities across diverse healthcare settings, including hospitals, clinics, community health centers, schools, and long-term care facilities. They can pursue roles as registered nurses, nurse practitioners, critical care nurses, pediatric nurses, or surgical nurses, depending on their specialization and level of education. Beyond clinical practice, nursing graduates can explore careers in public health, health education, research, administration, and even teaching in nursing institutions. With the growing global demand for healthcare professionals, nursing offers stable employment, opportunities for advancement, and the flexibility to work locally or internationally in both public and private sectors.

  • Attested High School Certificate and transcript (Grade 12 or Equivalent in each curriculum)
  • Attested School certificate and transcript for Grade 10 and 11
  • Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for High School curriculums other than the UAE system https://www.moe.gov.ae/En/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/CertEquivalent.aspx
    OR
  • Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for international applicants with certificates issued outside the UAE https://www.moe.gv.ae/en/eservices/servicecard/pages/certequivalent-out.aspx
  • Meet requirements of BSN Interview

English Language Requirements: The applicant is required to submit one of the below:

  • Secondary High School English Language Score 80%
    OR
  • TOEFL iBT with a minimum score of 61 (Institutional TOEFL is not accepted).
    OR
  • Academic IELTS with a minimum Band of 5.

    For IELTS and TOEFL results, they need to be valid as per the date of submitting the application.

    OR
  • English Placement Test at the University level is available for students who do not meet the English Language Requirements.
    Based on the test results, a foundation English course may be offered with an additional fee to enhance their proficiency to meet the requirements.

Note: No English Language requirement for students completing High School in a curriculum taught in English Language.

Admission Criteria Per Curriculum
The UAE Curriculum
  • Applicant must achieve in grade 12:
    • Elite Stream: minimum overall average 60% or
    • Advance Stream: minimum overall average 65% or
    • General Stream: minimum overall average 70% with at least 2 science subjects
    • The British Curriculum
    • A minimum grade of C or 4 in five O-Level subjects, including Mathematics, English, and Biology.
    • A minimum grade of D or 3 in two AS-Level subjects should be Biology or Chemistry OR
    • A minimum grade of D or 3 in one A-level subject should be Biology or Chemistry
    • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in UAE
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    The American Curriculum or SABIS Curriculum:
    • Applicants must pass successfully in Grade 12 with a minimum average 70% overall or a CGPA 2.5 on a scale of 4 or equivalent with a minimum 2 Science subjects.
    • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
    • Applicant to complete SAT1 Mathematics with a minimum score of 450 or equivalent as per MOE Equivalency requirements or complete the DMU Math Bridge course to achieve Equivalency.
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    The International Baccalaureate Curriculum (IB Diploma):
    • Applicants must achieve an IB Diploma and 3 in any 2 science subjects.
    • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    IB Subject Certificate:
    • Applicants must achieve an overall 21 points with a minimum grade of 3 points each
    • Applicant must complete English Language, Mathematics, and two Science subjects
    • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE.
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    Indian Curriculum:

    CBSE & State Board:

    • Applicants must achieve a minimum average of 55% in grade 12 (Science Stream)
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    Pakistani Federal Board:
    • Applicants must achieve a minimum average of 55% in grade 12 (Science Stream)
    • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE
    • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
    • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.
    Additional Information for Other Curriculums and Secondary School Qualifications Obtained Outside the UAE:

    Applicants from other curriculums and with high school certificates obtained outside the UAE may be required to submit an Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE) or World Education Services (WES) course-by-course evaluation when applying to evaluate the transcripts and have a standard GPA – this can be obtained from: http://www.ece.org or https://www.wes.org/

Details regarding the Recognition requirements for certificates obtained within or outside the UAE can be accessed through the MOHESR Website:

For Degrees from inside UAE:
https://www.mohesr.gov.ae/en/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/AttestationReggraduate.aspx

https://www.mohesr.gov.ae/en/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/UniversiyCertificateEquilization.aspx

Conditional Admission: GPA 2.0 - 2.99 on a scale of 4

During the conditional admission period, the applicant must fulfill the following requirements to maintain enrollment in the program; failure to do so may result in withdrawal from the program:

  • May register for a maximum of 9 credit hours during the first semester of study.
  • Must achieve a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale in the first semester. If this GPA is not attained, the university reserves the right to withdraw the student from the program.
2. Professional Experience
  • Preferably one year relevant work experience.
3. English Language Requirements:
  • IELTS score of 6.0 or above, or
  • TOEFL iBT score of 79 or above
  • Exemption from English proficiency requirement may be granted if prior education was in English, a letter for Language of Instruction is required. Additionally, all Master & PhD holders are not required to submit English proficiency.
4. Curriculum Vitae (CV)

A current CV detailing academic background, work experience, professional activities, & achievements.

5. Interview

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to attend a structured personal or virtual interview to to evaluate the applicant’s readiness for graduate-level study.

Refund Policy of Tuition Fees

Dubai Medical University admits only a limited number of students. If any student withdraws after admission, this will create a vacancy that could have been used by another qualified student. Therefore, the University administration is strict in their action for such students. They will not refund the fees paid at the time of admission until a valid reason is provided for admission cancellation.

Refund applies as follows:

  • A 5% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal before the beginning of the academic year.
  • A 25% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal during the first 10 working days of the academic year.
  • A 50% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal after 10 working days of the academic year.
  • If a student withdraws after the second semester start, no refund is granted at all.
  • In case of unforeseen circumstances, refund may only be accepted after Deans’ Council review based on student request supported with evidence.
  • Hostel and Transportation fees are refunded based on pro rata on a full monthly basis, not per day. (Month fraction is considered as a full month).
  • Refund requests for the above valid reasons should be made through the Student Affairs Department in collaboration with Accounts Department through a written request along with the original fee receipt. Refunds will be made after clearance of dues, if any. Refunds will be credited by bank transfer or Cheque to the same payer (student’s parent / guardian / sponsor) bank account and not given in cash.

The following are non-refundable:

  • Visa fee
  • Application fee
  • Transport fee
  • Seat Reservation fee.
  • Full tuition fee in case of dismissal/suspension for disciplinary reasons

Tuition Fee Installments

  • All students are expected to pay the annual tuition fees as per published dates set by the Accounts Department.
  • Tuition fees can be paid in full amount or in a maximum of four installments (two per semester). For installments, post-dated Cheques are required to be submitted.
  • Student or Parent can request to pay the amount with an installment plan to be approved by the Finance Manager.

content:
College of Nursing Frequently Asked Questions

How long is the duration of the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program (BSN)?

The duration of the program is four years.

How can I apply to the Bachelor of Nursing Program?

College of Nursing plans to offer 110 students for the BSN four-year program.

What are the application requirements for the BSN program?

Please refer to Admission criteria in this link.
BSN criteria

Is the BSN program recognized internationally?

DMU- Bachelor of Science in Nursing Program (BSN) is accredited locally by the Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, UAE.

What are the scholarship opportunities for students at DMU - BSN Program?

DMU-Nursing Program (BSN) Committee is keen to attract talented students and support their educational journey, so we will offer Merit Scholarship, and discounts to students as per criteria published.

What happens after I submit my application for BSN program?

Admission Process:

How much is the tuition fees of the BSN program?

Tuition fees for the Academic Year 2025-2026 is:

  • Annual Tuition Fees: AED 42,000/- (including 5% VAT)
  • Discounts:
  • 1st Year - 25% of the tuition fee AED 31,500/- (including 5% VAT)
  • 2nd Year - 15% of the tuition fee AED 35,700/- (including 5% VAT)
  • 3rd Year - AED 42,000/- (including 5% VAT)
  • 4th Year - AED 42,000/- (including 5% VAT)
Does DMU provide accommodation?

Yes, we have a female only hostel that is managed by DMU which is across the road from the campus. The cost is additional to the annual tuition fee.

please check link: https://dmu.ae/home/hostel-facilities/

Does DMU provide transportation?

Yes, we provide transportation, which is managed by DMU, and the cost is additional to the annual tuition fee. Daily transportation facilities are available for several destinations. Each weekend buses take students staying at the hostel back to their homes in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain and bring them back to the university on the next working day. Cost of Transport ranges from 3000 AED to 5000 AED according to destination.

Does DMU provide a student visa?

Yes, For more information, please check https://dmu.ae/home/visa-insurance/

How can I find out the status of my application in the BSN program?

Log into the admission portal https://admissions.dmu.ae/ with your email id and password to check your status. Below is explanation of each status
Submitted: Application is submitted and being reviewed by Nursing Admission Committee.
Screened In: Application is complete, and you will be invited for Interview and Placement exam if applicable.
Screened Out: Applicant is not eligible to join the program.
Invited for an Interview: you will receive an email with Interview date, time and location.
Conditional Admission: you are eligible to join once you submit all required admission documents.
Waitlisted: You are on a wait list and will be contacted once a place is available.
Regret:You didn’t meet our admission requirements and hence we are not able to offer you admission.

The ranking of applicants will be based on High School scores and Interview scores.

title: Nursing Simulation Center
content:
The Nursing Simulation Center at Dubai Medical University's College of Nursing provides students with an innovative, technology-enhanced learning environment that bridges classroom knowledge with real-world clinical practice. Designed to replicate authentic healthcare settings, our laboratories offer structured, hands-on, and simulation-based learning experiences that prepare students to deliver safe, competent, and patient-centered care.

Equipped with high-, medium-, and low-fidelity patient simulators, advanced task trainers, immersive learning technologies, and authentic clinical equipment, the labs allow students to practiceessential nursing skills in a safe and supportive environment before entering clinical placements.

Through realistic simulation scenarios, students develop clinical competence, critical thinking, communication, teamwork, clinical judgment, and decision-making skills while building the confidence required to excel in diverse healthcare settings.

title: About The College of Health Sciences
display_title: About The College of Health Sciences
content:
About the Health Sciences

The College of Health Sciences at Dubai Medical University is dedicated to preparing the next generation of highly skilled healthcare professionals who support modern healthcare systems through advanced clinical practice, technology, and patient-centered care. Building on the Dubai Medical University’s long-standing reputation in medical education, the College combines rigorous academic training with immersive clinical learning to ensure graduates are prepared for the evolving demands of modern healthcare.

A distinctive strength of the College is its integration within the Dubai Medical University Academic Health System, which includes Dubai Medical University Hospital (DMUH). As a university hospital operating in full coordination with DMU, DMUH provides students with structured and continuous clinical exposure in a real healthcare environment. This close academic-clinical integration enables students to apply theoretical knowledge directly to patient care while learning from experienced clinicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

The College also responds directly to the growing healthcare needs of Dubai and the United Arab Emirates, where rapid population growth and expanding healthcare infrastructure are increasing demand for well-trained allied-health professionals.

Through innovative education, advanced laboratories, and strong clinical partnerships, the College of Health Sciences contributes to workforce development, healthcare innovation, and improved patient outcomes across the region.

I warmly invite you to explore our college and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

content:

Student Success Center

The Student Success Center (SSC) at the College of Health Sciences (COHS) serves as a central hub for student support and guidance. It is designed to support students throughout their academic journey and personal growth by providing a supportive environment where they can seek assistance with academic, personal, or university-related concerns.

The SSC monitors student attendance and academic progress, identifies students who may require additional support, and works closely with students, faculty, academic programs, and university services to help students overcome challenges, stay engaged, and succeed in their studies. Through its various services, the SSC ensures that every student receives the guidance, assistance, and motivation needed to achieve academic success and personal development. These are in line with the UAE's strategic direction of promoting happiness and positivity.

Services provided:

    • Mentorship
    • Peer Tutoring
    • Student Attendance Monitoring
    • Student Grievances and Appeals
    • Academic Integrity and Conduct
    • Career Guidance

    The Student Success Center (SSC) is committed to supporting students throughout their academic journey by regularly monitoring academic progress and identifying students who may be at risk of academic difficulty. Through early intervention and personalized support, the SSC works closely with students, faculty mentors, and Associate Dean for Academic Affairs to identify challenges and develop effective strategies for academic success.

    As part of this support system, every student is assigned a faculty mentor who provides individualized academic guidance throughout their studies. Faculty mentors regularly monitor students' progress, meet with them to discuss academic performance, assist with academic planning, and help address any personal or academic challenges that may affect their success. They also support students in adjusting to university life, making informed academic decisions, and accessing appropriate university resources when needed.

    Through continuous mentoring, early intervention, and collaborative support, the SSC and faculty mentors help students stay on track, achieve their academic goals, and make the most of their university experience.

    The SSC organizes peer tutoring programs designed to create an inclusive learning community where students support each other in strengthening their understanding of course material and developing effective study strategies.

    Peer tutoring at COHS is delivered through structured, student-led initiatives under faculty supervision. The program is offered in a variety of learning formats, including one-to-one tutoring, small-group tutoring, study sessions, and workshops.

    Senior or high-achieving students support their colleagues in understanding challenging subjects, strengthening their knowledge, improving study habits, and building confidence in their learning.

    The SSC manages student attendance records and reviews absence excuses in learning and assessment sessions, in accordance with university policies. By maintaining accurate records, the SSC helps students stay on track with their studies and ensures transparency in attendance monitoring.

    Attendance alerts are sent regularly to students, and academic mentors are kept informed of attendance concerns to facilitate timely follow-up and support when needed.

    Absence & Missed Assessment Submission

    Students may sometimes face issues related to their academic or university experience. The SSC provides a clear process to submit grievances or appeals in a safe and fair environment. This ensures that student concerns are heard and addressed according to DMU policies. The SSC also guides students through the process and directs them to the appropriate individuals or committees when needed.

    Student Grievances and Appeals Submission

    The SSC promotes a culture of academic integrity, professionalism, and responsible conduct among students. The SSC provides guidance on university policies and supports students in understanding and meeting the expectations of the DMU community.

    The SSC also supports the implementation of the Student Misconduct and Academic Integrity Policy by assisting with the reporting, documentation, and follow-up of cases in accordance with university procedures. Students may seek guidance from the SSC regarding academic integrity and student conduct matters at any stage of the process.

    The Student Success Center (SSC) provides comprehensive career advising services to help students explore career options, develop professional skills, and prepare for a successful transition into the workforce. Through individual and group career advising sessions, students receive personalized guidance on career planning, goal setting, resume and interview preparation, and professional development.

    The SSC also organizes career readiness workshops, employer engagement events, and job fairs to connect students with potential employers and enhance their employability. In collaboration with internship and placement coordinators, employers, and professional organizations, the SSC helps identify internship, training, and potential employment opportunities for students, supporting their career growth and lifelong professional success.

    Dear College of Health Sciences Students,

    Greetings from the College of Health Sciences Student Success Center!

    We are delighted to welcome you to the Student Success Center at Dubai Medical University. On behalf of the College of Health Sciences (COHS), we are committed to supporting your academic, professional, and personal growth throughout your educational journey.

    At CHS, we recognize that every student brings unique strengths, aspirations, and talents. The Student Success Center is dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential by providing comprehensive academic support, student engagement opportunities, career guidance, wellbeing resources, and personalized development services that enrich your university experience.

    Our mission is to empower you to excel in your studies, cultivate leadership and professional skills, and become competent, ethical, and compassionate health sciences professionals who contribute meaningfully to improving healthcare and the wellbeing of the communities they serve.

    We encourage you to take full advantage of the resources, programs, and opportunities offered through the Student Success Center. Whether you need academic guidance, career planning, personal support, or opportunities to enhance your skills, our team is here to assist you every step of the way.

    We look forward to supporting your success, celebrating your achievements, and being part of your journey toward becoming future leaders in the health sciences.

    Welcome to the College of Health Sciences at Dubai Medical University. We wish you a successful, rewarding, and inspiring academic journey!

content:
Admission Requirements

  • Attested High School Certificate and transcript (Grade 12 or Equivalent in each curriculum)
  • Attested School certificate and transcript for Grade 10 and 11
  • Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for High School curriculums other than UAE system https://www.moe.gov.ae/En/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/CertEquivalent.aspx
  • OR
    Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education (MOE) for international applicants with certificates issued outside the UAEhttps://www.moe.gov.ae/en/eservices/servicecard/pages/certequivalent-out.aspx
  • Meet Interview requirements.

English Language Requirements: The applicant is required to submit one of the below:

  • Secondary High School English Language Score 80%

OR

  • TOEFL iBT with a minimum score of 61 (Institutional TOEFL is not accepted).

OR

  • Academic IELTS with a minimum Band of 5.

For IELTS and TOEFL results, they need to be valid as per the date of submitting the application.
OR

English Placement Test at the University level is available for students who do not meet the English Language Requirements. Based on the test results, a foundation English course may be offered with an additional fee to enhance their proficiency to meet the requirements.
Note:No English Language requirement for students completing High School in a curriculum taught in English Language.

Admission Criteria per Curriculum

The UAE Curriculum

  • Applicant must achieve in grade 12:
    • Elite/Advanced & ATHS Stream: minimum overall average 70%
    • If an applicant scores 65% to 69.9%, they are required to take a placement exam in Biology to meet admission requirements.

The British Curriculum

  • A minimum grade of C or 4 in five O-Level subjects should include 2 science subjects.
  • A minimum grade of D or 3 in two AS-Level subjects, one of which should be Biology or Chemistry ORA minimum grade of D or 3 in one A-level subject should be Biology or Chemistry
  • Applicants must provide an official letter from the school confirming current enrollment in Grade 12 (Year 13).
  • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
  • Result of Arabic Studies (MOE Exam) for grades 10, 11, and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory

The American Curriculum or SABIS Curriculum:

  • Applicants must pass successfully in Grade 12 with a minimum average of 70% overall or CGPA 2.5 on a scale of 4 or equivalent with a minimum 2 Science subjects.
  • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
  • Applicant to complete SAT1 Mathematics with a minimum score of 450 or equivalent as per MOE Equivalency requirements.
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

The International Baccalaureate Curriculum (IB Diploma):

  • Applicants must achieve an IB Diploma and 3 in any 2 science subjects.
  • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

IB Subject Certificate:

  • Applicants must achieve an overall 21 points with a minimum grade of 3 points each.
  • Applicant must complete English Language, Mathematics, and two Science subjects.
  • Attested transcript and certificate from the local relevant authority.
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11, and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE.
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

Indian Curriculum:
CBSE or ICSE or State Board:

  • Applicants must achieve a minimum average of 60% in grade 12 (Science Stream).
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

Pakistani Federal Board:

  • Applicants must achieve a minimum average of 60% in grade 12. (Science Stream).
  • Result of Arabic (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Arabic passport holders who completed High School in the UAE.
  • Result of Islamic Studies (MOE Exam) for grade 10, 11 and 12 for Muslims who completed High School in the UAE.
  • An Equivalency Certificate from MOE is mandatory.

Additional Information for Other Curriculums and Secondary School Qualifications Obtained Outside the UAE:
Applicants from other curriculums and with high school certificates obtained outside the UAE may be required to submit an Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE) or World Education Services (WES) course-by-course evaluation when applying to evaluate the transcripts and have a standard GPA - this can be obtained from: http://www.ece.org or https://www.wes.org/

  • Must meet the requirements for admission into a university in the country of origin.
  • The applicant must complete Grade 12 of education in school.

    • Education Authority (Home Country).
    • Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Home Country).
    • Embassy of the United Arab Emirates or the Embassy of the Country in the UAE.
    • Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the United Arab Emirates.
  • Applicants must submit an Equivalency Certificate from the Ministry of Education in the UAEhttps://www.moe.gov.ae/en/eservices/servicecard/pages/certequivalent-out.aspx

COUNTRY UNITED ARAB EMIRATES

Once your bank transfer has been completed, please send a copy of the receipt with the name and student ID to accounts@dmu.ae.
Cash / Cheques / Credit Card:

Refund Policy of Tuition Fees

Dubai Medical University admits only a limited number of students. If any student withdraws after admission, this will create a vacancy that could have been used by another qualified student. Therefore, the University administration is strict in their action for such students. They will not refund the fees paid at the time of admission until a valid reason is provided for admission cancellation.

Refund applies as follows:

  • A 5% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal before the beginning of the academic year.
  • A 25% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal during the first 10 working days of the academic year.
  • A 50% deduction is applicable on the full tuition fees if the candidate applies for withdrawal after 10 working days of the academic year.
  • If a student withdraws after the second semester start, no refund is granted at all.
  • In case of unforeseen circumstances, refund may only be accepted after Deans’ Council review based on student request supported with evidence.
  • Hostel and Transportation fees are refunded based on pro rata on a full monthly basis, not per day. (Month fraction is considered as a full month).
  • Refund requests for the above valid reasons should be made through the Student Affairs Department in collaboration with Accounts Department through a written request along with the original fee receipt. Refunds will be made after clearance of dues, if any. Refunds will be credited by bank transfer or Cheque to the same payer (student’s parent / guardian / sponsor) bank account and not given in cash.

The following are non-refundable:

  • Visa fee
  • Application fee
  • Transport fee
  • Seat Reservation fee.
  • Full tuition fee in case of dismissal/suspension for disciplinary reasons

content:
Master of Science in Health professions Education

Admission Requirements (Master/Diploma) Program

1. Academic Qualifications

  • A recognized bachelor degree (or equivalent) in a health professions-related field (e.g., Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences).
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 - scale or equivalent.
  • For non-GPA grading systems, please obtain a course-by-course evaluation from an Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE) or http://www.ece.org or World Education Services (WES) https://www.wes.org/
  • For degrees obtained outside the UAE, please obtain ECE – http://www.ece.org or WEShttps://www.wes.org/

All prospective applicants seeking admission must undergo the process of obtaining equivalency/recognition for their educational degrees through the UAE Ministry of Education. The attestation procedure varies depending on whether the degree was earned within or outside the UAE. Details regarding the Equivalency/Recognition requirements for certificates obtained within or outside the UAE can be accessed through the Ministry of Education https://www.moe.gov.ae/En/EServices/Pages/ServiceCatalog.aspx.

  • Master and PhD Holders are exempted from providing GPA requirements

Conditional Admission

Graduate with a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.5 to 2.9 on a 4.0 scale or its established equivalent shall be conditionally admitted to the first semester as follows:

  • Is allowed to take a maximum of nine credit hours of courses studied for the graduate program during the period of conditional admission, and
  • Must achieve a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale, or its established equivalent, in these nine credits of courses studied for the graduate program to progress to the second semester or be subject to dismissal.

Graduate with a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0 to 2.49 on a 4.0 scale or its established equivalent shall be admitted to the first semester as follows:

  • Is required to successfully complete a maximum of nine graduate-level credit hours as remedial preparation for the graduate program. These remedial courses are not for credit within the degree program.
  • Must achieve a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale, or its established equivalent, in these nine credits of remedial courses in order to be admitted to the graduate program or be subject to dismissal.

Graduate with a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of below 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or its established equivalent shall be admitted to the first semester if they have relevant professional experience as follows:

  • Is allowed to take a maximum of nine credit hours of courses studied for the graduate program during the period of conditional admission, and
  • Must achieve a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale, or its established equivalent, in these nine credits of courses studied for the graduate program to progress to the second semester or be subject to dismissal.

2. Professional Experience

  • At least one year of professional experience in health professions education, clinical practice, academic teaching, or administration in a healthcare or educational institution.
  • Preference is given to applicants currently involved in teaching or training in health professions education

3. English Language Proficiency

    • IELTS score of 6.0 or above, or
    • TOEFL iBT score of 79 or above, or
  • Exemption from English proficiency requirement may be granted if prior education was in English, a letter for Language of Instruction is required. Additionally, all Master & PhD holders are not required to submit English proficiency.

4. Personal Statement

  • A written statement (500-750 words) outlining the applicants:
    • Motivation for pursuing the MHPE program.
    • Career goals in health professions education.
    • Relevant experience and how the program aligns with their professional development.

5. Letters of Recommendation

A letter of recommendation from academic or professional supervisors, attesting to the applicants:

  • Academic capability
  • Professional commitment
  • Suitability for graduate study in education

6. Curriculum Vitae (CV)

  • A current CV detailing academic background, work experience, professional activities, & achievements

7. Interview

Shortlisted candidates may be invited for a personal or virtual interview to assess:

  • Communication skills
  • Commitment to health professions education
  • Alignment with the program's objectives

title: Simulation Facility
content:
The Facilities at Simulation Center:

The Simulation Center is covering halls 202, 204 and 206 (OSCE Center). This stage of our Simulation Center consists of several clinical environments:

  • Reception Area: This area serves as an entrance for the students to register their attendance and receive the task that they’re appointed to perform. Plus, it serves as hospital admission area to simulate patient registration, check-in, and waiting rooms in a clinical setting in a medical simulation scenario.
  • Task Training Room: Students use this space to enhance their psychomotor skills. This Lab combines theory with practice, allowing them to experience self-learning and helping them to improve their readiness for an actual clinical environment.
  • OB/GYN Room: Equipped with a high-fidelity birthing manikin and high-fidelity infant manikin; students are practicing different scenarios of OB/GYN and Neonatology care scenarios in this room.
  • ICU/Emergency Room:This room comprises both adult and pediatric multipurpose high-fidelity manikins. Students train and enhance their skills for ICU practice and emergency response.
  • Outpatient Room: Students receive Standardized Patients, as in a real clinic using this room. They learn the process of examining, assessing, and treating a patient. Students practice history taking, decision making and practice communication skills in this area.
  • Debriefing Room: The end of each simulation session, the instructors invite the students to reflect on their actions, decisions, and overall performance during the simulation. Participants receive feedback on their strategies, communication, problem-solving and other skills relevant to the simulation utilizing this room.
  • Control Room: A major component of any simulation center - this space provides the ability to monitor, record, and remotely control the simulation scenario, where facilitators and simulation technicians monitor and run each scenario.
  • OSCE Center & Surgical Simulation Training (Program Expansion): Objective Structured Clinical Exams (OSCEs) provide a reliable and standardized method for assessing resident performance through direct observation which can focus on specific areas or skills. The main objective of an OSCE is to assess and evaluate the skills of medical students in applying evidence and appropriate treatment options in critical situations with a standardized patient.

title: Career Guidance
content:
Career Guidance at DMU

The Career Guidance Division at DMU supports students and graduates across Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing, and Biomedical Sciences in identifying and achieving their career goals. Our mission is to enhance professional readiness and competitiveness in the healthcare sector by providing tailored guidance, resources, and opportunities.

We help students explore diverse career options, develop essential competencies, and set goals aligned with their aspirations. Through networking events, workshops, and alumni engagement, students gain valuable insights into evolving healthcare trends and the wide range of career pathways available within and beyond clinical practice. Alumni also play an active role in mentoring, sharing experiences, and contributing to DMU’s efforts to prepare future-ready healthcare professionals.

Our services include:
  • Career advising sessions to set personal and professional goals.
  • Guidance on internship, residency, and training requirements tailored to Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing, and Biomedical Sciences.
  • Support with postgraduate training and employment documents (e.g., residency match, fellowship, or specialist licensing).
  • Information on local, regional, and international specialization opportunities across healthcare disciplines.
  • Advising on licensing and equivalency procedures in the UAE and abroad.
  • Preparatory sessions for international licensing exams, including:
    • Medicine: USMLE, UK Medical Licensing Assessment (UKMLA / MLA), AMC, MCCQE
    • Pharmacy: NAPLEX, PEBC
    • Nursing: NCLEX-RN, HAAD, DHA, MOH
    • Biomedical Sciences: ASCP, IBMS, local equivalency exams
  • Sharing clinical elective, placement, and observership opportunities with application guidance.
  • Workshops and forums on diverse career pathways in healthcare, academia, research, and industry.
  • Support in CV/resume writing, interview preparation, and job search strategies.
  • Participation in external career conferences and networking events.
  • Organization of career fairs and on-campus recruitment events.
  • Communication of job opportunities and employer connections for graduates.
  • Alumni-led sessions such as “Meet the Expert” and “Success Story” talks.

title: Students of Determination
content:
Students of Determination

Our Commitment

At Dubai Medical University (DMU), we are committed to creating an inclusive and empowering learning environment for all students, including Students of Determination. Our goal is to ensure that every student has equitable access to education, facilities, and opportunities, allowing them to achieve academic and personal success without barriers.

Accessible Facilities

DMU’s campus is designed to provide full accessibility and comfort for Students of Determination.

Mobility & Accessibility:

  • Step-free access to all buildings, ramps, and elevators.
  • Designated accessible parking spaces close to entrances.
  • Tactile paths, clear signage, and visual contrast for ease of navigation.
  • Accessible restrooms and prayer facilities across campus.
  • Reserved parking spaces close to main entrances for ease of access
  • Wheelchairs provided upon request.
  • Ramps are available across campus for smooth wheelchair and mobility access.
  • Elevators are available in all buildings.
  • The university assists in arranging necessary classroom modifications to ensure accessibility if required.

Learning Spaces:

  • Lecture halls equipped with assistive audio systems.
  • Adjustable desks and accessible laboratory benches.
  • Quiet study areas for students needing reduced sensory stimulation.
  • Computer stations equipped with accessibility software such as screen readers and magnifiers.

Health and Wellbeing:

  • On-campus health clinic with accessible consultation rooms.

Procedures for requesting mental health related accommodations on campus/ students of determination

  • The student fills out the health declaration form and indicates their disability and provides a medical report of their diagnosis in addition to the highlighted needs on campus.
  • The head of student well-being or the counselor arranges a meeting with the student for review of the information provided and coordinates with related academic departments for application of the accommodation request.
  • The head of student well-being or the counselor onfidentially communicates this medical information with the consent of the student in providing the services on campus with concerned members (faculty members, operations, etc.)
Student Support Services

Academic Support:

  • Counseling, advising, and mentorship, are explicitly provided by the university and specifically include services for Students of Determination (SOD)
  • Counseling services support students facing a wide range of challenges, including emotional, social challenges and academic concerns
  • “Increase Font Size” option available in all online learning resources and exams.

Health & Psychological Support:

  • Counselling and mental health services in a confidential setting through our dedicated Counselor.
  • Referrals for psychological therapy when needed.

Administrative Assistance:

  • Priority in class registration, housing, and campus transportation.

Schemes and Initiatives:

  • Paid Transport support for daily commutes to and from the university.
  • Reasonable adjustments are provided for exam schedules, assignment deadlines, and other academic requirements.
  • Training for faculty and staff to ensure sensitivity and awareness of students’ diverse needs.
Accommodation

Accessible Rooms Include:

  • Step-free access and widened doorways.
  • Roll-in bathrooms with safety bars.
  • Adjustable furniture and lower countertops.
  • Visual and vibrating fire alarms for hearing-impaired students.
  • Students with dietary restrictions have access to suitable meal options at the cafeteria.

Additional Residence Services:

  • 24-hour support and emergency assistance.
  • Accessible shuttle services between accommodation and campus.

Application & Documentation:

Students seeking support or accommodations should contact the Counselor Office. Required documentation may include medical, psychological, or educational assessments describing the nature of the condition and the type of support needed.

All personal information is treated with strict confidentiality and shared only with staff directly involved in providing accommodation.

Friday: 8:00 AM to 12 Noon
